_comment: Оправа лаборатории image-clone: 5 листов по 12 ячеек, прогон 512x512. Сюжеты живёт в queue.json, сюда вкладываются на время генерации.

variants.name: copy
variants.style: smooth airbrushed painterly rendering without visible line, matte hand-painted materials, gentle ambient occlusion, low gloss, readable silhouette
variants.negative: chibi, toddler proportions, baby face, doll face, toy figure, blind box vinyl, clay render, glossy plastic, shiny enamel, 3d print, cute child, photorealism, photograph, ink outlines, line art, sketch, grayscale, character sheet, turnaround, multiple views, reference sheet, split frame, collage, two characters, dark background, gradient background, scenery, landscape, text, letters, watermark

unit-01.style: stylized hand-painted fantasy game character illustration from a single comic-painted art bible, heroic stocky proportions: head about one sixth of the total height, broad shoulders, thick arms, compact build, mature stylized cartoon face with simplified exaggerated features, large readable eyes, bold expression, hand-painted, never a photograph, matte painterly surfaces with soft airbrushed shading
unit-01.frame: single full-body fantasy character standing exactly as described, entire figure visible from head to boots, whole object with a clear empty margin around it, nothing touching the frame, centered, front view facing the camera straight on, head up and eyes open looking at the viewer, isolated on plain white background with no scenery and no blurred shapes, soft grey contact shadow under the feet only, no second copy, no turnaround, no grey clay 3d render, no inset pictures, nothing in the corners
